svg.text: My name is Dima and I come from a small family. I live with my parents and
my younger sister, who is ten. Every morning my mother (1) ______
breakfast for all of us. After school I always (2) ______ my homework
first, and then I help my mother with the housework — I usually (3) ______
the dishes. At weekends we go to my grandparents' house in the village. I
really look (4) ______ to my grandfather because he is a very (5) ______
and kind man. He (6) ______ me how to fish when I was six.
